source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API

prompt.en: Find three colors that make this artwork feel alive.
prompt.zh: 找出让这件作品有生命力的三个颜色。
prompt.fr: Trouve trois couleurs qui rendent cette oeuvre vivante.

guide.en: Look at The Dispatch of the Messenger. Which colors arrive first, and which colors stay quietly behind?
guide.zh: 看看《The Dispatch of the Messenger》。哪些颜色最先跳出来？哪些颜色安静地留在后面？
guide.fr: Observe The Dispatch of the Messenger. Quelles couleurs arrivent en premier, et lesquelles restent discrètes ?
